name: Starship (Star Fox 64)
summary: Starship packaged with game assets generated from your verified owned ROM.

release_rules.notes: Packaging layout inspected for v2.0.0, commit cb19785b51698185a688e17ba1a34c7889195bdb. Release archives use Starship-Barnard-Alfa-Linux.zip and Starship-Barnard-Alfa-Windows.zip. Future releases must preserve the expected archive members. The documented ROM-selection workflow must be checked again if upstream changes its asset-generation process.

first_run.summary: Portkeeper generates and includes sf64.o2r before download. Run the launcher; no ROM selection is needed. Native Windows startup and gameplay are untested.

linux.description: Official upstream project release archive for Linux v2.0.0. Contains the AppImage runtime, configuration, controller database, documentation, and asset-processing support files.

windows.description: Official upstream project release archive for Windows v2.0.0. Contains the Windows executable, bundled O2R file, configuration, controller database, documentation, and asset-processing support files. The bundled O2R is not assumed to replace the required owned ROM.

source_checks.description: Upstream still supports headless Torch extraction
The runtime still looks for the prepared game archive
The configured USA revision hash remains supported

linux.instructions: Extract the entire ZIP and run Launch.sh. The generated sf64.o2r is included; keep it with the runtime. Startup and gameplay must be tested for this package.

windows.instructions: Extract the entire ZIP and run Launch.cmd. The generated sf64.o2r is included; keep it with the runtime. Startup and gameplay must be tested for this package.

saves: Settings and save locations require source and native runtime checks; gameplay and full portability are not yet verified.

linux: Linux system capable of executing the upstream Starship AppImage.
Compatible graphics drivers and OpenGL support.
Writable package directory for configuration and saves.
windows: Windows system compatible with the upstream Starship.exe release.
Compatible graphics drivers supporting the selected rendering backend. The README documents DirectX 11 as the Windows default and OpenGL as an alternative.
Writable package directory for configuration and saves.

limitations: Requires your supported owned USA ROM. Portkeeper generates sf64.o2r with its pinned Torch CLI and the release configuration.
New releases must pass source and archive compatibility checks; new game data starts untested.
Windows startup and gameplay have not been tested.
